policies.title: Encryption at Rest
policies.requirement: Vendor must encrypt customer data at rest using AES-256 or an approved equivalent.
policies.expected_commitment: Explicit AES-256 or approved-equivalent encryption for stored customer data.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add an explicit requirement for AES-256 or approved-equivalent encryption at rest.

policies.title: Encryption in Transit
policies.requirement: Vendor must protect customer data in transit using TLS 1.2 or later.
policies.expected_commitment: Explicit TLS 1.2 or later for customer-data transmission.
policies.remediation_guidance: Require TLS 1.2 or later for all customer-data transmissions.

policies.title: Identity and Access Management
policies.requirement: Vendor must use unique user identities, least privilege, and periodic access reviews at least quarterly.
policies.expected_commitment: Unique identities, least privilege, and quarterly or more frequent access reviews.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add unique-account, least-privilege, and quarterly access-review obligations.

policies.title: Privileged Access Security
policies.requirement: Privileged and remote administrative access must require multi-factor authentication and be limited to authorized personnel.
policies.expected_commitment: MFA and authorization controls for privileged and remote administration.
policies.remediation_guidance: Require MFA and explicit authorization for all privileged and remote administrative access.

policies.title: Security Logging and Monitoring
policies.requirement: Vendor must log security-relevant events, monitor them, and retain logs for at least 180 days.
policies.expected_commitment: Security event logging, monitoring, and at least 180 days of retention.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add security-event monitoring and a minimum 180-day log-retention commitment.

policies.title: Vulnerability Remediation
policies.requirement: Vendor must remediate critical vulnerabilities within 15 calendar days and high vulnerabilities within 30 calendar days.
policies.expected_commitment: Critical remediation within 15 days and high remediation within 30 days.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add measurable critical and high vulnerability remediation deadlines.

policies.title: Security Incident Notification
policies.requirement: Vendor must notify the customer of a confirmed security incident affecting customer data within 72 hours.
policies.remediation_guidance: Amend the agreement to require notice within 72 hours of confirmation.

policies.title: Audit and Assurance Rights
policies.requirement: Customer must receive reasonable audit rights or current independent assurance evidence, with direct audit available when material control concerns remain unresolved.
policies.expected_commitment: Independent assurance plus a path to direct audit for unresolved material concerns.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add access to current assurance reports and a direct-audit right for unresolved material concerns.

policies.title: Data Retention
policies.requirement: Vendor must retain customer data only for a defined period or until an objective documented deletion event occurs.
policies.expected_commitment: A measurable duration or objective deletion trigger.
policies.remediation_guidance: Replace vague retention wording with a defined duration or objective deletion event.

policies.title: Secure Data Return and Deletion
policies.requirement: Vendor must return or delete customer data within 45 days after termination and define how backup copies are removed.
policies.expected_commitment: Return or deletion within 45 days and a defined backup-deletion cycle.
policies.remediation_guidance: Require deletion or return within 45 days and specify the maximum backup-removal period.

policies.title: Subprocessor Management
policies.requirement: Vendor must impose equivalent data-protection obligations on subprocessors and provide at least 30 days advance notice of material subprocessor changes.
policies.expected_commitment: Written flow-down obligations and at least 30 days advance notice.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add equivalent written obligations and at least 30 days advance notice for material subprocessor changes.

policies.title: Service Continuity and Recovery
policies.requirement: Vendor must maintain tested continuity plans with annual exercises, a recovery time objective no greater than 8 hours, and a recovery point objective no greater than 4 hours.
policies.expected_commitment: Annual testing, RTO of 8 hours or less, and RPO of 4 hours or less.
policies.remediation_guidance: Add annual continuity testing and measurable RTO and RPO commitments within policy limits.
